raw_segments.text: Of all the Europeans, the English are those who have mixed least with the Negroes.
More mulattoes are to be seen in the south of the Union than in the North, but still
they are infinitely more scarce than in any other European colony.
Mulattoes are by no means numerous in the United States.
They have no force peculiar to themselves, and when quarrels originating in differences
of color take place, they generally side with the whites.
